node.statement: Lemma 4.2 (Concentration of GKKT): The averaged estimator rho_hat_avg = (1/n) sum_i rho_hat_i satisfies Pr[||rho_hat_avg - |v><v|||_infty >= q] <= 2 exp((4 log 3)d - n*q^2/704). Proof: (i) Fix a unit vector |z> and apply the Bernstein inequality for sub-exponential random variables [FR13, Theorem 7.30] using the moment bounds from Lemma 4.1, giving Pr[|<z|rho_hat_avg - |v><v||z>| >= q] <= 2 exp(-n*q^2/704). (ii) Take a (1/3)-covering net N of the unit sphere with |N| <= (3/(1/3))^{2d} = 9^{2d} points [Ver18, Cor. 4.2.11]. (iii) Union bound over N, then extend to all |z> via the covering net argument [Ver18, Lemma 4.4.2] which shows ||A||_infty <= 2 max_{z in N} |<z|A|z>| for Hermitian A.
